errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the time period begins in 1950. The x-axis shows a time period starting 800,000 years ago and ending at 0, where 0 is defined as the year 1950.

errors.text_span: Тя е източник на данни за една от социалните последици на глобализацията, а именно изменението на климата.
errors.evidence: This sentence provides an interpretation of the data's significance (social consequences of globalization, climate change) that is not explicitly stated in the figure itself. The figure only shows the change in CO2 levels.

errors.text_span: започва от около 260 ppm през 1950 г.
